messages:
Leah (People Ops): Quick sync  - Priya accepted offer but needs urgent travel to India next week. Shes on OPT. Can we confirm remote start + benefits/I-9 approach?
Tom (Recruiter): She expects 8-12 days away but passport renewal might push it. Wants to start remotely if possible.
Sanjay (Benefits): We can provisionally enroll and backdate if docs come within 30 days. Dependent enrollment windows still apply.
Ellen (Payroll): Payroll can process pay if W-4 and bank info provided. I-9 Section 2 has to be done in person after she returns if she is abroad at start.
Immigration-Counsel-Bot: Counsel note: OPT allows work while valid. Travel carries re-entry risk without visa stamp. Filing COS to H-1 while candidate leaves US before approval may complicate status. Recommend remote onboarding and in-person I-9 after return, or delay travel if adjudication is imminent. Consider premium filing if timeline tight.
Leah (People Ops): Two options: keep start date with remote onboarding or delay until in-person I-9. Team ok with remote access and non-customer tasks initially.
Priya (Candidate): Id prefer to keep start date and begin remotely. Ill sign forms digitally and bring originals when Im back.
Tom (Recruiter): Ill send candidate the counsel advisory and onboarding checklist.
Immigration-Counsel-Bot: Draft advisory for candidate:
``
Hi Priya,
- Travel while on OPT may make re-entry harder if you need a visa stamp.
- Bring your EAD, I-20 with travel signature, and offer letter when traveling.
- Benefits can be backdated if enrollment paperwork completed within 30 days.
- I-9 must be completed in-person after your return; please schedule with HR within 3 business days.
- If your trip may exceed 2 weeks, inform us to discuss other filing options.
Regards, Redwood Immigration Counsel
```
Leah (People Ops): We will provide laptop and VPN day one. Action items: @Sanjay confirm backdating (EOD), @Ellen confirm payroll checklist, @Tom send advisory to candidate.
Sanjay (Benefits): Confirmed: backdate possible within 30-day window; will send link.
Ellen (Payroll): Sending payroll checklist and bank form to Tom.
Tom (Recruiter): Priya confirmed travel 06/20-06/28 and wants a 06/22 start. Sending advisory now.
Leah (People Ops): Proceeding with remote start and in-person I-9 on 06/29. Reopen thread if any blocker.
